# Action Genome

Human-object relationship annotations over Charades video frames.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** A Charades clip and person-object boxes with relationship annotations.

**Output / label:** Relationship cues such as looking at or holding an object; no original intention target.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://github.com/JingweiJ/ActionGenome)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://github.com/JingweiJ/ActionGenome), [intention_use](https://orca.cardiff.ac.uk/174841/1/1-s2.0-S0957417424030148-main.pdf)

## Intention in this dataset

Scene relationships provide contextual intention cues in the DSG construction. Original Action Genome labels are not human intention ground truth.

**Relevance:** `related` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2020

**Domains:** daily_activities, human_object_interaction  
**Intention types:** object_interaction  
**Tasks:**   
**Modalities:** rgb, object_state  
**Formats:** video, structured_annotation
